name: Dance Dance Revolution Tournament
blurb:
• Format: 8-player limit, single elimination, skill-based seeding.
• Matches: 1v1 (Best of 3 songs).
• Song Selection: Higher seed elects P1/P2 side or card draw order (7 cards drawn from a 6-song pool per round with pick/bans).

blurb:

name: Cube Master
blurb:
• Format: 25-player limit across 2 rounds.
• Photo Submission: Judged by Sam Fang (Cube Master on YouTube).
• Round 1 (Groups): Live 5-person group challenges (unique mystery task per group) judged by our live Cube Master. Top performer per group advances.
• Final Round: 1 final surprise task, attempted individually while sequestered.
